title: Terms to Enterprise Knowledge Graph
description: Interactive infographic MicroSim of the ten steps to move from a simple list of business terms to an agentic EKG
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the stages of knowledge graph evolution, from a terms list and business glossary to a controlled vocabulary, semantic ontology, knowledge graph, and enterprise knowledge graph
Distinguish a controlled vocabulary from a semantic ontology by the relationships each is able to express
Explain what an AI-enhanced EKG and a real-time EKG add beyond a static enterprise knowledge graph
Trace the ten-step path an organization follows to move from simple business terms to real-time agentic intelligence
Evaluate an organization's current metadata maturity by locating it on this progression
